identification: Mixed bulk LEGO in a carton: sorted 24-compartment case of small parts, a tub of minifig-scale bits, orange ramp/ladder elements, and assembled vehicles (red race car, red/white and blue town vehicles, modern City fire truck and camper van). Mostly modern with some older 1980s-90s style pieces. No boxed sets visible, no obvious rare minifigs.

viewing_check: Look under the top layer for boxed sets, instruction books, minifigs (Star Wars, Harry Potter, Collectable Minifigures), and any vintage Technic, Space or Castle sets. Check the sorted case for rare pieces and whether vehicles are complete. Photograph the bottom of the box.
